usage: tunnel session [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [NAME]

positional arguments:
  NAME         switch to this session; leave it out to print the one in hand
               and what else is on disk

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json       print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
